title: MZ how do i make 16x16 sprite s look bigger and pixel perfect in rpg maker mz?

posts.author: serialex
posts.body:
hi, i’m new to rpg maker mz and trying to use 16x16 sprites. the problem is they look really small and the game feels zoomed out. i want that clean, zoomed-in pixel art look like in undertale or omori, where the sprites are small but still appear big and sharp.
i’m confused how devs do this. is there a proper way to zoom the camera or scale the game so it looks right?
any help would mean a lot, thanks.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
serialex said:
is there a proper way to zoom the camera or scale the game
Click to expand...
yes and no.
Zooming always has its own problems, but for someone in your situation the best way is using a different route.
You need to use one of the better image programs, one where you don't simplky scale or zoom, but can select which formula to use for scaling.
Then scale all your sprites with that program to 300% using the formula for "nearest neighbor" - it might be called differently in different image programs however.
You need to be able to select this formula to have any chance of pixel-perfect scaling, so using plugins instead would be hit and go depending on which mathematics a specific plugin uses.
and you can only scale full multiples anyway, so 200% or 300% or 400%. You would instantly lose the pixel-perfect look when using 150% or 110% or any other between value.
